notes.title: FUTURE SHAPERS
notes.content:
Over the past few months, we've been working tirelessly to reimagine the core of "Sunset".
Get ready... some exciting news is on the horizon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42115937/88bb7977b368c05c3a321e10a08d9511bc8fa112.png[/img]

notes.title: EPIC NEWS
notes.content:
Five years ago, when we first opened a blank project on Unreal Engine and started learning and experimenting, we never expected to receive the honor of becoming an Epic MegaGrants recipient.

The support from the MegaGrant will be a huge boost for the development of Sunset: Broken Embers and will provide us with the motivation to work even harder to achieve our goals.
We would like to express our gratitude to all the wonderful people at Epic and in the MegaGrant program for their help and support, and for believing in our project.
